g.text: Node-Agent restart | bounded Operator Type-2 fixture contract
Root-private journals remain on the same worker.
Installation/node, boot, namespace and configuration must match.
The scoped runner does not assert uninterrupted service or a convergence SLA.
Recovery assertions must pass before normal lifecycle cleanup continues.
Implemented fixture/test contract, not new live acceptance evidence.
